title: The Beaver Dam
text: Beavers the size of bears have dammed the river, and the valley behind them has drowned. Their dam is a wall of whole trunks, gnawed to points and woven tight. It is the finest timber in the land, and they are watching you look at it.

outcomes.text: Fine timber, gnawed to points, as hard as bone.
The beavers come, and they are the size of bears, and their teeth are made for felling trees.

options.label: The shrewdest trades with the beavers for their offcuts.

outcomes.text: They drive a hard bargain, chattering, and do not take their eyes off your axes.
Clever, terrible work. The House carpenters will want to hear of it.
